item.title: ‘This is How We Do It’ singer Montell Jordan on beating prostate cancer, redefining success: ‘God is healing’
item.description: Ahead of National Marriage Week, "This is How We Do It" singer Montell Jordan and his wife, Kristin, opened up about health, faith, marriage and family. #MontellJordan #KristinJordan #health #faith #cancer #NationalMarriageWeek

item.title: Landmark ordinance setting minimum age of marriage to 18 signed in Pakistan
item.description: In a landmark move welcomed by Christian rights advocates, the governor of Pakistan’s Punjab Province on Wednesday signed into law an ordinance raising the minimum legal age of marriage to 18, and making child marriage a non-bailable offense punishable by up to seven years in prison. #Pakistan #PunjabProvince #marriage #childmarriage

item.title: HHS Secretary RFK Jr. says war against ultra-processed foods is 'spiritual'
item.description: A day after former heavyweight champion Mike Tyson declared war against processed foods in a Super Bowl commercial, Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said that his agency's war with ultra-processed foods, which he says are poisoning the population, is “spiritual.” #RFK #Ultraprocessedfoods #RealFood #MakeAmericaHealthAgain

item.title: Puerto Rico gives legal protection to unborn babies; pro-lifers praise 'historic moment'
item.description: Puerto Rico passed a new law amending its penal code on murder to include the killing of unborn babies. #PuertoRico #unbornbabies #abortion #prolife #GonzalesColon

item.title: 2,000-year-old 'Pilgrim's Path' to Temple Mount in Jerusalem opens to public
item.description: An ancient road built in the days of Jesus that led from the Pool of Siloam up to the Jerusalem Temple Mount has been opened to the public for the first time. #Jerusalem #TempleMount #PilgrimsPath #KingHerod #Jesus #PontiusPilate

item.title: Chelsea Clinton's decade-old claim against Baptists and abortion sparks fresh backlash
item.description: Chelsea Clinton has prompted fresh backlash for her reported decade-old claim that she left the Baptist church for Methodism as a child because the Baptists were talking to her about abortion in Sunday school when she was 6 years old. #ChelseaClinton #HillaryClinton #BillClinton #abortion #SouthernBaptistConvention

item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom marked the signing of a bill that grants $90 million in “emergency” funding for Planned Parenthood and other abortion providers. #California #GovGavinNewsom #PlannedParenthood #Abortion

item.title: Fewer than a third of churchgoers read the Bible daily: Lifeway
item.description: Fewer than one in three Protestants who attend church services at least once a month read the Bible on a daily basis, according to a recent report from Lifeway Research. #Bible #reading #LifewayResearch #Scripture #discipleship #survey #church
